_comment: Default configuration for generate-value-report.mjs. CLI flags override these values.
_soloRoleComment: Engineer level used for the Solo Engineer scenario. Default: senior — the minimum level capable of autonomous delivery on non-trivial software.
_seniorEfficiencyFactorComment: Fraction of mid-level hours a senior engineer needs for the same work. 0.70 = senior completes the same scope in 70% of the estimated time.
_regionComment: Region ID from regional-rates.json used for headline cost figures. Options: sf_bay | nyc_boston | seattle_denver_austin | chicago_dc_la | south_midwest | national
_outputDirComment: Directory where value-report.html and value-report.pdf are written. --output flag overrides the full path (including filename).
